routeFarePriceManagement.name: Route Fare Price Management

request.description:
Create a new route fare price. Requires ADMIN or REVENUE_ANALYST role.

**Required Roles**: `ADMIN`, `REVENUE_ANALYST`

**Request Body:**
- `routeId`: Route ID (UUID v7)
- `fareClassCode`: Fare class code (e.g., 'YS')
- `basePrice`: Base price (decimal)
- `taxRate`: Tax rate (decimal, e.g., 0.1 = 10%)
- `feeRate`: Fee rate (decimal, e.g., 0.05 = 5%)
- `effectiveFrom`: Effective from date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `effectiveTo`: Effective to date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional)
- `isActive`: Is active (boolean)
- `priority`: Priority (integer, higher = more priority)
- `notes`: Notes (optional)

Get all route fare prices. Requires ADMIN, REVENUE_ANALYST, or DISTRIBUTION_MANAGER role.

**Required Roles**: `ADMIN`, `REVENUE_ANALYST`, `DISTRIBUTION_MANAGER`

item.name: Get Route Fare Price by ID

request.description:
Get route fare price by ID. Requires ADMIN, REVENUE_ANALYST, or DISTRIBUTION_MANAGER role.

**Path Parameter:**
- `id`: Route fare price ID (UUID v7)

Update route fare price. Requires ADMIN or REVENUE_ANALYST role.

**Path Parameter:**
- `id`: Route fare price ID (UUID v7)

**Request Body (all fields optional):**
- `basePrice`: Base price
- `taxRate`: Tax rate
- `feeRate`: Fee rate
- `effectiveFrom`: Effective from date
- `effectiveTo`: Effective to date
- `isActive`: Is active
- `priority`: Priority
- `notes`: Notes

Delete route fare price. Requires ADMIN or REVENUE_ANALYST role.

**Path Parameter:**
- `id`: Route fare price ID (UUID v7)

baggageAllowanceManagement.name: Baggage Allowance Management

request.description:
Create a new baggage allowance. Requires ADMIN or ANCILLARY_MANAGER role.

**Required Roles**: `ADMIN`, `ANCILLARY_MANAGER`

**Request Body:**
- `fareClassCode`: Fare class code (e.g., 'YS')
- `checkedBaggageKg`: Checked baggage weight in kg (optional)
- `checkedBaggagePieces`: Checked baggage pieces (optional)
- `carryOnKg`: Carry-on baggage weight in kg
- `carryOnPieces`: Carry-on baggage pieces
- `carryOnDimensions`: Carry-on dimensions (optional, e.g., '55x40x20')
- `isDomestic`: Apply to domestic routes (boolean)
- `isInternational`: Apply to international routes (boolean)
- `notes`: Notes (optional)

Get all baggage allowances. Requires ADMIN, ANCILLARY_MANAGER, CALL_CENTER, or DISTRIBUTION_MANAGER role.

**Required Roles**: `ADMIN`, `ANCILLARY_MANAGER`, `CALL_CENTER`, `DISTRIBUTION_MANAGER`

Get baggage allowance by ID. Requires ADMIN, ANCILLARY_MANAGER, CALL_CENTER, or DISTRIBUTION_MANAGER role.

**Path Parameter:**
- `id`: Baggage allowance ID (UUID v7)

Update baggage allowance. Requires ADMIN or ANCILLARY_MANAGER role.

**Path Parameter:**
- `id`: Baggage allowance ID (UUID v7)

**Request Body (all fields optional):**
- `checkedBaggageKg`: Checked baggage weight
- `checkedBaggagePieces`: Checked baggage pieces
- `carryOnKg`: Carry-on weight
- `carryOnPieces`: Carry-on pieces
- `carryOnDimensions`: Carry-on dimensions
- `isDomestic`: Apply to domestic routes
- `isInternational`: Apply to international routes
- `notes`: Notes

Delete baggage allowance. Requires ADMIN or ANCILLARY_MANAGER role.

**Path Parameter:**
- `id`: Baggage allowance ID (UUID v7)

cabinServiceManagement.name: Cabin Service Management

body.raw:
{
  "cabinClassCode": "Y",
  "fareClassCode": "YS",
  "serviceType": "meal",
  "serviceName": "Hot Meal",
  "description": "Hot meal and beverage served during flight",
  "isIncluded": true,
  "price": null,
  "isActive": true,
  "displayOrder": 1,
  "iconUrl": "https://example.com/icons/meal.png"
}

request.description:
Create a new cabin service. Requires ADMIN or ANCILLARY_MANAGER role.

**Required Roles**: `ADMIN`, `ANCILLARY_MANAGER`

**Request Body:**
- `cabinClassCode`: Cabin class code (optional, e.g., 'Y')
- `fareClassCode`: Fare class code (optional, e.g., 'YS')
- **Note**: At least one of `cabinClassCode` or `fareClassCode` must be provided
- `serviceType`: Service type (meal, entertainment, wifi, priority_boarding, lounge_access, seat_selection, extra_legroom, other)
- `serviceName`: Service name
- `description`: Description (optional)
- `isIncluded`: Is included (free) or purchasable (boolean)
- `price`: Price (required if isIncluded = false, null if isIncluded = true)
- `isActive`: Is active (boolean)
- `displayOrder`: Display order (integer)
- `iconUrl`: Icon URL (optional)

Get all cabin services. Requires ADMIN, ANCILLARY_MANAGER, CALL_CENTER, or DISTRIBUTION_MANAGER role.

**Required Roles**: `ADMIN`, `ANCILLARY_MANAGER`, `CALL_CENTER`, `DISTRIBUTION_MANAGER`

Get cabin service by ID. Requires ADMIN, ANCILLARY_MANAGER, CALL_CENTER, or DISTRIBUTION_MANAGER role.

**Path Parameter:**
- `id`: Cabin service ID (UUID v7)

body.raw:
{
  "serviceName": "Premium Hot Meal",
  "description": "Premium hot meal with beverage",
  "isIncluded": false,
  "price": 200000,
  "isActive": true,
  "displayOrder": 2
}

request.description:
Update cabin service. Requires ADMIN or ANCILLARY_MANAGER role.

**Path Parameter:**
- `id`: Cabin service ID (UUID v7)

**Request Body (all fields optional):**
- `serviceName`: Service name
- `description`: Description
- `isIncluded`: Is included
- `price`: Price
- `isActive`: Is active
- `displayOrder`: Display order
- `iconUrl`: Icon URL

Delete cabin service. Requires ADMIN or ANCILLARY_MANAGER role.

**Path Parameter:**
- `id`: Cabin service ID (UUID v7)
